questions.note: Prior preterm birth plus short cervix: vaginal progesterone and cerclage are both supported; ACOG 2021 progesterone cervical-length cutoff is usually 20 mm, not 25 mm.
Atelectasis is classically the first-day cause, but endometritis is the most common cause after cesarean over the first several days.
Under ASCCP 2019, ages 21-24 with ASC-US and HPV positive are usually followed with repeat testing in 1 year rather than immediate colposcopy; colposcopy is still the best of the listed options.
